content.title: Summoned Scale Payoff | Energy Formation, Adult Identity, Guardian Reveal
content.summary: A tide archivist summons an atlas-scale guardian from map lines. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: An empty ritual space establishes the baseline. + Energy resolves into one stable adult identity. + At least three identity anchors survive the scale change. + One deliberate gesture motivates the larger activation. + The giant form remains spatially behind the original person.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on an empty basalt tide temple as a narrow copper spiral descends to one dry platform. Push to her profile while those three identity anchors remain exact. Pull wide as a vast translucent atlas figure rises behind her, sharing the same wrist-seal geometry without replacing her.

Energy resolves into one stable adult identity.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A tide archivist summons an atlas-scale guardian from map lines. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
